invariant: A canonical Swing may belong to at most one active EQ cluster on the same side
atomicity: Cluster creation reserves both initial member ids atomically
Member append checks and reserves the candidate id atomically
A failed reservation produces no cluster/member mutation
Terminal lifecycle removes the cluster from the active-membership index but does not erase historical membership

newClusterCreation.eligibleInitialMembers: Both Swing primitives must be unassigned to another active same-side cluster
newClusterCreation.selection: Use the existing deterministic chronological bounded-anchor ordering

historicalReuse.oldMemberAsNewFormationAnchor: Normally rejected by the unchanged first-Swing lifecycle gate after SWEPT/BROKEN
historicalReuse.meaning: A new cluster after an old cluster finishes must be formed by newly confirmed qualified Swing primitives; this is sequential reuse of a price area, not simultaneous member overlap.

shadowMetrics.SWING_USED_IN_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_EQ: Count canonical Swing ids present in more than one ACTIVE cluster as-of each checkpoint
shadowMetrics.SIMULTANEOUS_ACTIVE_OVERLAP: Count active cluster pairs sharing at least one canonical Swing at the same evaluationTime
shadowMetrics.HISTORICAL_SEQUENTIAL_REUSE: Count price-area or cluster-side recurrence after the previous cluster is terminal, without shared active membership

target: SWING_USED_IN_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_EQ should approach zero by invariant, not by a score or threshold change
